notes.title: Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things
notes.answer: AI and IoT are technologies that can make services more useful and connected, but they should be developed and used ethically.

Both technologies can improve services and daily life, but they also raise concerns about privacy, security, fairness, jobs and accountability.

written.text: Q10.8. Describe the concept of algorithmic bias and its implications in AI-powered decision-making processes. Suggest strategies to mitigate the risks of algorithmic bias.
modelAnswer: Algorithmic bias occurs when an AI system produces unfair decisions or outcomes.
It can arise from biased training data or from assumptions in how the system is designed.
The system may then perpetuate existing societal biases in decisions such as selection, access to services or other important areas.

Risks can be reduced by using representative data and checking data and models for unfair patterns.
Systems should be tested regularly, made as transparent as possible and reviewed by people.
Clear accountability is also needed so that problems can be identified and corrected.

modelAnswer: AI and IoT systems should be fair and should not discriminate against individuals or groups.
Their design and decisions should be as transparent as possible, and organizations should be accountable for their effects.
